WebSocket: file-created notifications received per second
spec.description: CREATED events received by all WebSocket readers, per second. If every reader gets every event, this equals uploads per second times the number of WebSocket readers at that level. Grouped by the ramp level the file was uploaded at, read from its name, so a notification that arrives after its level ended still counts for that level. "unattributed" is for files uploaded during a transition between levels.

spec.title: Changes feed: new files received per second
spec.description: New files found by all changes-feed readers (GET /sharings/drives/:id/_changes), per second. If every reader gets every file, this equals uploads per second times the number of changes readers at that level. Grouped by the ramp level the file was uploaded at, read from its name, so a notification that arrives after its level ended still counts for that level. "unattributed" is for files uploaded during a transition between levels.

options.content:
**DEV · Platform InfluxDB · 60 s collection**

Shared host activity, not isolated test-organization usage. Dots are sampled values; sub-minute spikes may be missed. HTTP p99 stays per host; process CPU (cores) differs from host CPU (%). S3 / RabbitMQ telemetry is unavailable in this view. Missing data is not zero.

spec.title: Latest Stack sample (UTC)
spec.description: Last DEV source sample within the selected window. Compare with the run end; this is not a guarantee that every metric is fresh.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "dev" and r._measurement == "http_all_total_duration" and r._field == "count" and r.host =~ /^${stack:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000.0, host: r.host}))
